stories.title: A.I. Gone Rogue? Trump Proposes Not New Rules but an ‘A.I. Force.’
stories.sum: The president proposed a follow-up to his Space Force but continued to dismiss worries about A.I.’s pace or potential for harm.

stories.title: Andrew Yang Calls for AI Kill Switch as Safety Fears Mount
stories.sum: The former presidential candidate said lawmakers should impose liability rules and waiting periods on frontier AI firms as autonomous agents raise new cyber and labor concerns.

stories.title: Zara Larsson criticises White House for using her song in deportation video
stories.sum: The White House removed Larsson's Midnight Sun from one of its reels after the artist called the clip "dehumanising".

stories.title: Department of Energy launches $215 million race to build quantum computer by 2028
stories.sum: Agency aims to select teams for milestone-driven competition by year’s end
